condition.name: clickhouse_durability_unverified
entered_when: batch acceptance cannot be freshly read back
persisted audit finds marker, event, payload, selector, object, or setting mismatch
frozen audit coverage is partial, expired, gapped, or unavailable

freshness_rule: coverage belongs to its frozen round and each persisted subrange expires independently; slow completion never refreshes an expired subrange
payload_rule: reconstruct actual stored key, operation, source version, schema identity and tagged values before comparing recomputed, stored and journal hashes
